content: Lefiwɑ u Gɛɛsɔni kɑ Kehɑti kɑ Mɛrɑri mɑrɑ.
Ye Gɛɛsɔni u seewɑ, mɑ u Libini kɑ Simɛi mɑrɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Kehɑtin bibu, berɑ Amurɑmu, kɑ Yisehɑri, kɑ Heboroni, kɑ Usiɛli.
Be bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Mɛrɑrin bibu, berɑ Mɑkili kɑ Musi. Beni kpurowɑ bɑ kuɑ wiruɡibu Lefin bwese kɛri sɔɔ.
Mɑ Gɛɛsɔni u seewɑ u Libini mɑrɑ. Mɑ Libini u seewɑ u Yɑsɑti mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yɑsɑti u seewɑ u Simmɑ mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Simmɑ u seewɑ u Yoɑsi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yoɑsi u seewɑ u Ido mɑrɑ. Mɑ Ido u seewɑ u Serɑki mɑrɑ. Mɑ Serɑki u seewɑ u Yɑtɑrɑi mɑrɑ.
Kehɑtibɑ sɔɔ, Kehɑti u seewɑ u Aminɑdɑbu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Aminɑdɑbu u seewɑ u Kore mɑrɑ. Mɑ Kore u seewɑ u Asiri mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Asiri u seewɑ u Ɛlikɑnɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Ɛlikɑnɑ u seewɑ u Abiɑsɑfu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Abiɑsɑfu u seewɑ u Asiri mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Asiri u seewɑ u Tɑhɑti mɑrɑ. Mɑ Tɑhɑti u seewɑ u Uriɛli mɑrɑ. Mɑ Uriɛli u seewɑ u Osiɑsi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Osiɑsi u seewɑ u Sɔɔlu mɑrɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Ɛlikɑnɑn bibu ɡɑbu, berɑ Amɑsɑi kɑ Akimɔti.
Ahimɔtin bweseru sɔɔ, Akimɔti u seewɑ u Ɛlikɑnɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Ɛlikɑnɑ u seewɑ u Sofɑi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sofɑi u seewɑ u Nɑhɑti mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Nɑhɑti u seewɑ u Eliɑbu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Eliɑbu u seewɑ u Yeroɑmu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yeroɑmu u seewɑ u Ɛlikɑnɑ ɡoo mɑrɑ.
Sɑmuɛlin bibɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yoɛli kɑ Abiyɑ.
Mɛrɑrin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, Mɛrɑri u seewɑ u Mɑkili mɑrɑ. Mɑ Mɑkili u seewɑ u Libini mɑrɑ. Mɑ Libini u seewɑ u Simɛi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Simɛi u seewɑ u Usɑ mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Usɑ u seewɑ u Simɛɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Simɛɑ u seewɑ u Hɑɡiyɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Hɑɡiyɑ u seewɑ u Asɑyɑ mɑrɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkororu yii yeru wɑɑwɑ, sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Dɑfidi u Lefi ben ɡɑbu kuɑ wom kowobun wiruɡibu Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Berɑ bɑ rɑ wom kowobu kpɑre Yinni Gusunɔn kuu bekuruɡirun wuswɑɑɔ sere Sɑlomɔɔ u rɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru bɑnɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Bɑ ben sɔmburu kuɑwɑ dee dee nɡe mɛ bɑ bu ten woodɑ wɛ̃.
Be bɑ kuɑ wom kowobun wiruɡibu kɑ ben bibun bweseru wee. Kehɑtin bweseru sɔɔ, Hemɑniwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ wom kowobun wiruɡii. Win sikɑdobɑrɑ Yoɛli kɑ Sɑmuɛli,
kɑ Ɛlikɑnɑ, kɑ Yeroɑmu, kɑ Eliɛli, kɑ Toɑ,
kɑ Sufu, kɑ Ɛlikɑnɑ, kɑ Mɑhɑti, kɑ Amɑsɑi,
kɑ mɑɑ Ɛlikɑnɑ ɡoo, kɑ Yoɛli ɡoo kɑ Asɑriɑ, kɑ Sofoni,
kɑ Tɑhɑti, kɑ Asiri, kɑ Abiɑsɑfu, kɑ Kore,
kɑ Yisehɑri, kɑ Kehɑti, kɑ Lefi, kɑ Isireli.
Asɑfu u mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wom kowobun wiruɡii turo. Wiyɑ u rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ Hemɑnin nɔm ɡeuɔ u n nùn somimɔ. Win sikɑdobɑrɑ Berekiɑ, kɑ Simɛɑ,
kɑ Mikɑɛli, kɑ Bɑɑseyɑ, kɑ Mɑɑkiyɑ,
kɑ Etini, kɑ Serɑki, kɑ Adɑyɑ,
kɑ Etɑni, kɑ Simmɑ, kɑ Simɛi,
kɑ Yɑsɑti, kɑ Gɛɛsɔni, kɑ Lefi.
Mɛrɑrin bweseru sɔɔ, be bɑ rɑ womusu ko, bɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ Hemɑnin nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ. Ben wiruɡiiwɑ Etɑni. Etɑni win sikɑdobɑrɑ Kisi, kɑ Abudi, kɑ Mɑluku,
kɑ Hɑsɑbiɑ, kɑ Amɑsiɑ, kɑ Hilikiyɑ,
kɑ Amusi, kɑ Sɑni, kɑ Semɛɛ,
kɑ Mɑkili, kɑ Musi, kɑ Mɛrɑri, kɑ Lefi.
Ben mɛro bisi be bɑ tie, berɑ bɑ rɑ sɔmɑ ko ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ kpuro.

Aroni kɑ win bibun bweserɑ bɑ rɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu ko yɑ̃ku yeru wɔllɔ kpɑ bu mɑɑ turɑre dɔ̃ɔ doke mi. Berɑ bɑ rɑ sɔmɑ kpuro ko dii te tɑ dɛɛre ɡem ɡem sɔɔ kpɑ bu torɑrun yɑ̃kunu ko Isirelibɑn sɔ̃ nɡe mɛ Mɔwisi, Gusunɔn sɔm kowo u bu yiire.
Aronin bweserun tɔ̃kɑ wee. Aroni u seewɑ u Eleɑsɑɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Eleɑsɑɑ u seewɑ u Finɛɛsi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Finɛɛsi u seewɑ u Abisuɑ mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Abisuɑ u seewɑ u Buki mɑrɑ. Mɑ Buki u seewɑ u Usi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Usi u seewɑ u Serɑyɑ mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Serɑyɑ u seewɑ u Mɛrɑyɔtu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Mɛrɑyɔtu u seewɑ u Amɑriɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Amɑriɑ u seewɑ u Akitubu mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Akitubu u seewɑ u Sɑdɔku mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sɑdɔku u seewɑ u Akimɑsi mɑrɑ.
Wuu si bɑ Lefin bibun
bweseru wɛ̃
Ye bɑ tɛtɛ tobɑ, be bɑ ɡbiɑ bɑ tem wɛ̃ berɑ Kehɑtin bwese kɛrɑɡibu, Aronin bweseru sɔɔ. Ben wɑ̃ɑ yenu kɑ ben kpɑrɑ yenu kɑ ben tem nɔɔ burɑ yenu wee.
Niyɑ Heboroni ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yudɑn temɔ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu ni nu kɑ ye sikerenɛ.
Adɑmɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnu, Kɑlɛbu, Yɛfunɛn biiwɑ bɑ mi wɛ̃.
Wuu si bɑ Aronin bibun bweseru wɛ̃, siyɑ Heboroni mi bɑ ko n dɑ kpikiru de, kɑ Libinɑ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Yɑtiri, kɑ Ɛsitemɔɑ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu,
kɑ Hilɛni kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Debiri kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu,
kɑ Asɑni kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Bɛti Semɛsi kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu,
kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn tem wuu sini, Gibeɑ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Alemɛti kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Anɑtɔtu kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu. Wuu si kpuro su kuɑwɑ mi wɔkurɑ itɑ nɡe mɛ bwese kɛri yi, yi ɡeeru nɛ.
Ye bɑ mɑɑ tɛtɛ tobɑ, Kehɑtin bibun bwese te tɑ tie, tɑ wusu wɔkuru wɑ Efɑrɑimun bwese kɛrɑn tem sɔɔ kɑ Dɑnun bwese kɛrɑɡim sɔɔ, kɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukumɡim sɔɔ.

Gɛɛsɔnin bibun bweseru tɑ wusu wɑwɑ wɔkurɑ itɑ nɡe mɛ ben bwese kɛrin ɡeerɑ nɛ. Wuu si, su wɑ̃ɑwɑ Isɑkɑrin bwese kɛrɑn tem sɔɔ kɑ Asɛɛn bwese kɛrɑɡim sɔɔ, kɑ Nɛfitɑlin bwese kɛrɑɡim sɔɔ kɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑɡim sɔɔ Bɑsɑniɔ.
Ye bɑ mɑɑ wure bɑ tɛtɛ tobɑ, wusu wɔkurɑ yiruwɑ Mɛrɑrin bibun bweserɑ wɑ Rubɛnin bwese kɛrɑn tem sɔɔ, kɑ Gɑdiɡiɑn tem sɔɔ, kɑ Sɑbuloniɡiɑn tem sɔɔ nɡe mɛ ben bwese kɛrin ɡeerɑ nɛ.
Isirelibɑ bɑ mɑɑ Lefibɑ wusu ɡɑsu wɛ̃ kɑ sin kpɑrɑ yenu.
Bɑ wuu si ɡɔsɑwɑ kɑ tɛtɛ Yudɑn bwese kɛrɑn temɔ, kɑ Simɛɔn bwese kɛrɑɡim sɔɔ, kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bwese kɛrɑɡim sɔɔ.
Kehɑtin bibun bwese te tɑ mɑɑ tie, tɑ wusu wɑwɑ Efɑrɑimun bwese kɛrɑn tem sɔɔ.
Wuu si bɑ bu wɛ̃, siyɑ Sikɛmu ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Efɑrɑimun ɡuurɔ, kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu. Miyɑ bɑ ko n dɑ kpikiru de. Kɑ Gesɛɛ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu,
kɑ Yokumɛɑmu kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Bɛti Horoni kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu,
kɑ Ayɑloni kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ sere mɑɑ Gɑti Rimɔɔ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Wuu si Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukum mu mɑɑ wɑ, siyɑ Anɛɛ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Bileɑmu kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu. Siyɑ bɑ Kehɑtin bwese kɛrɑɡii be bɑ tie wɛ̃.
Bɑ mɑɑ Gɛɛsɔnin bwese kɛrɑn tɔmbu wusu wɛ̃. Wuu si bɑ wɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukum min di, siyɑ Golɑni ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Bɑsɑniɔ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Asitɑrɔtu kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Wuu si bɑ wɑ Isɑkɑrin bwese kɛrɑn min di, siyɑ Kedɛsi kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Dɑbɑrɑti kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu,
kɑ Rɑmɔti kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ sere Anɛmu kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Wuu si bɑ wɑ Asɛɛn bwese kɛrɑn min di, siyɑ Mɑsikɑli kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Abudoni kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu,
kɑ Hukɔku kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ sere Rehɔbu kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Wuu si bɑ wɑ Nɛfitɑlin bwese kɛrɑn min di, siyɑ Kedɛsi ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gɑlilen temɔ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Hɑmɔɔ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ sere Kiriɑtɑimu kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Bɑ Lefi be bɑ tie Mɛrɑrin bweseru sɔɔ wusu wɛ̃. Wuu si bɑ wɑ Sɑbulonin bwese kɛrɑn min di, siyɑ Rimɔnɔ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Tɑbori kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Wuu si bɑ wɑ Rubɛnin bwese kɛrɑn min di Yuudɛnin ɡuru ɡiɔ, Yerikon deedeeru sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ, siyɑ Beseri ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem sɑɑrɑɔ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Yɑsɑ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu,
kɑ Kedemɔti kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ sere Mɛfɑti kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Wuu si bɑ mɑɑ wɑ Gɑdin bwese kɛrɑn min di, siyɑ Rɑmɔti, Gɑlɑdin temɔ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ Mɑhɑnɑimu kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu,
kɑ Hɛsiboni kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu, kɑ sere Yɑsɛɛ kɑ yen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Isɑkɑrin bibun bweseru
